sloka: ऋषीणाम् अभयम् दत्तम् कृत क्षेमाः च दण्डकाः ।धर्षितम् च जनस्थानम् रामेण अक्लिष्ट कारिणा ॥३-३३-१३॥
transliteration: ṛṣīṇām abhayam dattam kṛta kṣemāḥ ca daṇḍakāḥ ।dharṣitam ca janasthānam rāmeṇa akliṣṭa kāriṇā ॥3-33-13॥

translations.english: Rama, the effortless performer of formindable tasks, has assured safety to the sages. Peace and happiness was restored to Dandaka forest but Janasthana has been ravaged.
